hints.title: All Anagram Starting Indices Obstacle
hints.text: Extracting and sorting every substring of length len(p) scales quadratically. How can shifting a window by one character update the count array in constant time?

hints.title: Sliding Window Multi-Set Invariant
hints.text: The window always spans [i - len(p) + 1, i]. Subtracting the leaving character and adding the entering character keeps the window frequency exact.

hints.title: Rolling Count Window Procedure
hints.text: Count frequencies of p and the prefix of s of length len(p). If initial counts match, record index 0. Then iterate i from len(p) to len(s) - 1: increment count for s[i] and decrement count for s[i - len(p)]. Whenever the frequency arrays match, append i - len(p) + 1.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: len(s): length of string s (1 <= len(s) <= 3 * 10^4)
len(p): length of pattern p (1 <= len(p) <= 3 * 10^4)
complexity.notes: Fixed-size sliding window with 26-element array comparisons in O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Sorting each window substring of length len(p) requires O(len(s) * len(p) log(len(p))) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Array of size 26 stores character counts with constant auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Using fixed 26-character arrays or a single match-difference count to achieve linear runtime.
